tools.name: timicx_list_time_entries
tools.description: List time bookings (project_time) with date, employee, project, task, duration in seconds, status and billable flag. Filter by date range, employee, project, task or status. Timicx API: GET /ws/2.0/project_time.json.

tools.name: timicx_get_time_entry
tools.description: Get one time booking by id, with employee, project, task, duration, begin and end. Timicx API: GET /ws/2.0/project_time/{id}.json.

tools.name: timicx_list_running_timers
tools.description: List the live timers that are running or paused right now. Timicx API: GET /ws/2.0/project_time/running.json.

tools.name: timicx_list_employees
tools.description: List the employees of the Timicx system (user name, full name, employee number, enabled flag). Timicx API: GET /ws/2.0/employees.json. Some employee logins may not see the full list.

tools.name: timicx_get_employee
tools.description: Get one employee by id, with groups, email, employee number and standard hourly rate. Timicx API: GET /ws/2.0/employees/{id}.json.

tools.name: timicx_list_projects
tools.description: List projects with name, description, active flag and parent. Use top_level_only for the projects at the top of the tree. Timicx API: GET /ws/2.0/projects.json.

tools.name: timicx_get_project
tools.description: Get one project by id, with its parent, children, estimated time and estimated completion date. Timicx API: GET /ws/2.0/projects/{id}.json.

tools.name: timicx_list_tasks
tools.description: List the tasks (activities) that time can be booked on, with billable flag and rate. Timicx API: GET /ws/2.0/tasks.json.

tools.name: timicx_get_task
tools.description: Get one task by id, with its billable flag, group restriction and external rate. Timicx API: GET /ws/2.0/tasks/{id}.json.

tools.name: timicx_create_time_entry
tools.description: Book time: a finished time entry with date, task and duration in seconds (optional project, employee, begin, end, billable, comment). Writes a new booking. Timicx API: POST /ws/2.0/project_time.json.

tools.name: timicx_update_time_entry
tools.description: Change fields of a time entry. Only the given fields change: the tool reads the booking first and sends all writable fields back. At least one field is needed. Timicx API: GET then PUT /ws/2.0/project_time/{id}.json.

tools.name: timicx_start_timer
tools.description: Start a live timer (like a stopwatch) for the logged-in employee. Optional project, task and comment. Timicx API: POST /ws/2.0/project_time/start.json.

tools.name: timicx_pause_timer
tools.description: Pause a running live timer. Optional comment. Timicx API: PUT /ws/2.0/project_time/pause/{id}.json.

tools.name: timicx_resume_timer
tools.description: Resume a paused live timer. Optional comment. Timicx API: PUT /ws/2.0/project_time/resume/{id}.json.

tools.name: timicx_finish_timer
tools.description: Finish a live timer and keep its time as a booking. Optional comment. Timicx API: PUT /ws/2.0/project_time/finish/{id}.json.

tools.name: timicx_delete_time_entry
tools.description: Delete a time booking. A running or paused live timer is cancelled the same way. This cannot be undone. Timicx API: DELETE /ws/2.0/project_time/{id}.json.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: timicx_get_employee · Public sink: timicx_get_employee, timicx_create_time_entry, timicx_start_timer · Destructive: timicx_delete_time_entry.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: timicx_get_employee · Public sink: timicx_get_employee, timicx_create_time_entry, timicx_start_timer · Destructive: timicx_delete_time_entry

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
